title: Fix null pointer in user session handler
description: Resolves NPE in SessionManager when user token expires mid-request. Added null check and graceful token refresh.
author: raj.patel

title: Add dark mode support to settings page
description: Implements dark mode toggle in user settings. Persists preference to user profile. CSS-only change with no backend impact.
author: emily.torres

title: Upgrade PostgreSQL driver from 42.5.1 to 42.7.3
description: Upgrades pgjdbc driver to address connection pool leak under sustained load. Fixes known issue with PreparedStatement caching.
author: raj.patel

title: Reduce report generation memory footprint
description: Refactored nightly report generator to stream results instead of loading full dataset into memory. Reduces peak memory from 7.2GB to 1.8GB.
author: nina.volkov

title: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints
description: Implements token bucket rate limiting (100 req/min per API key) on all public endpoints via API Gateway middleware.
author: james.okafor

title: Remove deprecated payment provider Stripe v2 integration
description: Removes legacy Stripe v2 integration code. All payment flows now use Stripe v3 SDK. Breaking if any internal tooling still references v2 endpoints.
author: emily.torres
